message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: ci

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - '**'
    tags-ignore:
      - '**'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run lint
      - run: pnpm -C nuxt-module dev:prepare
      - run: pnpm run test:unit --coverage
      - run: pnpm run build
      - run: pnpm run test:types
      - run: pnpm run size

      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a single job with no explicit timeout, so a hung run can consume the default 360-minute job budget. Measured evidence for P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) shows adding an explicit job timeout cut median elapsed time 41s -> 30s (26.8%) with identical success (3/3) on a measured CI workflow fork. This repository's historical CI runs complete in roughly 33-68s, so a 5-minute budget gives ample headroom for valid runs including cold dependency installation while bounding runaway consumption. All lint, test, typecheck, build, and coverage steps are preserved; no permissions, secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access is added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT"]
}
